name: Cosmos
description: A deep-space look for the whole window: stars and a nebula behind everything, a ringed planet, a rocket on the message box, tonight's moon, and an orbital wallpaper for new chats.
settings_description: Cosmos draws a sky behind Zeron's window. Its colours come from the Cosmos theme (Settings → Themes); the nebula and the light on the rocket follow your accent.

settings.label: Show
settings.description: With its theme, the sky comes and goes as you switch themes in Settings → Themes (it knows the Cosmos theme by its window colour).

settings.label: Stars
settings.description: A starfield behind the sidebar and the title bar.

settings.label: Sky behind the conversation
settings.description: A fainter sky inside the chat's card, fading out toward the message box.

settings.label: Nebula
settings.description: Clouds of colour in your accent's hues.

settings.label: Ringed planet
settings.description: Rising at the sidebar's bottom corner.

settings.label: Twinkling and shooting stars
settings.description: A few stars breathe and one crosses now and then. Still while the window is hidden or Reduce Motion is on.

settings.label: Rocket on the message box
settings.description: It lifts off while the chat's agent is working and lands when it's done.

settings.label: Which rocket
settings.description: Stylized models of real ones. The Falcon 9 folds its legs as it leaves and opens them as it lands.

settings.label: Tonight's moon
settings.description: The Moon's real phase, after a chat's title. Point at it for its name.

settings.label: Motion
settings.description: How the orbital view behind a new chat moves: drifting clouds, twinkling stars, and a little parallax under the pointer.
